data.one_liner: Adds Bootstrap 5 components and CSS integration to the Bones_UI Dart package.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles Bootstrap 5 JavaScript and CSS, providing ready‑to‑use Bootstrap widgets like accordions, navbars, and date range pickers for Bones_UI. It also includes SCSS sources for custom theming and a compatibility layer for Bootstrap 4 styles.
use_when: You need Bootstrap‑styled UI components in a web‑only Dart app using Bones_UI
You want to customize Bootstrap SCSS themes without adding manual HTML/JS
avoid_when: You are building for mobile platforms only
You prefer a pure Flutter widget library without external CSS/JS dependencies
strengths: Bundled JS/CSS and SCSS for easy theming
weaknesses: Web‑only; not usable on mobile or desktop Flutter apps
Relies on external Bootstrap assets, increasing bundle size
